name: Sierra Leone Colony and Protectorate
alt: Colony and Protectorate of Sierra Leone

predecessors.name: Freetown Colony
predecessors.text: the Freetown peninsula, the Sierra Leone Company's colony taken over by the Crown in 1808

ledger.x: 1808: 'It took responsibility of Sierra Leone in 1808 and made it a Crown colony.'
31 August 1896: 'the hinterland of Sierra Leone became a British protectorate'.
27 April 1961: 'Sierra Leone gained independence from the United Kingdom on 27 April 1961' (granted in a ceremony in Freetown; on 4 May 1960 the UK had agreed to the date).

certainty.note: No frontier on any page; the peninsula only.
Modern country stands for the protectorate; boundary dates with France and Liberia are not on the pages.
